orientation.where_this_fits: Second exact-contract market-structure reproduction in Programme 002; tests whether canonical Henry Hub forward curves preserve externally documented seasonal structure before prediction/model selection.
orientation.programme_question: Which externally documented Henry Hub behaviours reproduce under source-faithful exact-contract data and semantics?

parent_question: Does the exact listed-contract Henry Hub M1-M6 curve exhibit material seasonal structure between winter-withdrawal and injection months?
uncertainty_reduced: Whether a fixed, scale-free M1-M6 curve statistic shows a material seasonal difference after exact maturity alignment and year-block dependence adjustment.
mechanism: Seasonal demand and inventory cycles alter scarcity and convenience yield, producing systematic seasonal differences in the level and shape of the Henry Hub futures curve.

hypotheses.h0: The standardized winter-withdrawal versus injection difference in the predeclared monthly M1-M6 log-curve slope is smaller than the scientific MEPI.
hypotheses.h1: The standardized seasonal difference in the predeclared monthly M1-M6 log-curve slope reaches at least the scientific MEPI; sign is reported rather than imposed because the direct literature inventory does not specify the repository-specific M1-M6 sign.

expected: The predeclared winter-withdrawal and injection distributions of monthly M1-M6 log-curve slope differ by at least the scientific MEPI with uncertainty excluding the disconfirming region.
disconfirming: The seasonal slope contrast is below the scientific MEPI under informative power.
The seasonal pattern disappears when exact listed-contract maturity alignment and the fixed monthly snapshot rule are enforced.
Any apparent seasonal difference depends on changing the M1-M6 statistic, month-selection rule, or season definition after outcome access.

forecast.prediction_timestamp_semantics: not predictive; descriptive last identity-eligible session of each calendar month
forecast.target_timestamp_semantics: same-day exact M1-M6 final-settlement curve snapshot
forecast.information_cutoff_semantics: monthly date selection uses identity/expiration only; statistic and season rules fixed before price access

model.training_rules: No model fitting or tuning. Each month uses the last trade date with >=6 exact active listed contracts. Statistic is OLS beta of ln(final settlement) on normalized maturity rank (rank-1)/5 for M1..M6. Winter-withdrawal=Nov-Mar; injection=Apr-Oct.

evaluation.inference_procedure: calendar-year block bootstrap of the fixed monthly seasonal contrast

benchmarks.interpretation: no winter-withdrawal versus injection M1-M6 log-slope difference

outcome_logic.success: Absolute standardized winter-withdrawal versus injection M1-M6 slope difference reaches >=0.75 MEPI, the block-bootstrap interval excludes zero/disconfirming region, and exact-maturity robustness does not invalidate the seasonal claim.
outcome_logic.failure: The seasonal contrast remains below 0.75 with informative uncertainty or disappears under required exact-maturity/calendar-consistent robustness.
outcome_logic.inconclusive: The estimated seasonal difference is nonzero/directionally structured but uncertainty overlaps the 0.75 MEPI/disconfirming region.
